# EPUB Reader Dependencies

The Aetheria fiction reader vendors its browser dependencies so published books remain readable without a third-party CDN.

- `epub.min.js`: epub.js 0.3.93, BSD-2-Clause, <https://github.com/futurepress/epub.js>
- `jszip.min.js`: JSZip 3.10.1, MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later, <https://github.com/Stuk/jszip>

The adjacent license files are copied from their respective packages.
